comparison.title: Side menu keyboard focus
comparison.description: Verified baseline for #2854. The viewer loads a shared local two-paragraph fixture so both sides start with the same real content. With the side menu showing, Tab can focus a cloned Add block button and then drop focus to the document body; the live Add block button also ignores Enter and Space. After carries a local experimental patch that makes closing popover copies inert and activates Add block from the button. This is a partial fix: keyboard-only discovery of the side menu is not solved.

steps.instruction: The editor already contains the two-paragraph fixture. Hover the first paragraph so the side menu appears and leave the pointer over that block.
steps.expectedBefore: Record how the side menu appears and whether it is reachable without a pointer.
steps.expectedAfter: The side menu still appears on hover. Record whether anything about focus or activation changed.

steps.instruction: With the caret in the hovered paragraph, press Tab. Check the focus status and the focused element immediately, then again after half a second.
steps.expectedBefore: Focus may land on a fading copy of Add block and then disappear. Record whether it reaches a real control.
steps.expectedAfter: Focus should reach the adjacent 'Focus after editor' button and stay there.

steps.instruction: With the side menu showing, focus 'Focus after editor', press Shift+Tab twice to reach the live Add block button, then press Enter and Space.
steps.expectedBefore: Record whether the suggestion menu opens from the keyboard.
steps.expectedAfter: The suggestion menu should open. Record whether focus remains usable.

steps.instruction: Repeat the focus and activation checks at 320px, light, dark, forced-colours light, forced-colours dark and reduced motion.
steps.expectedBefore: Record focus loss, invisible focus, or controls that cannot be activated.
steps.expectedAfter: Record what changed. Automated checks do not establish WCAG conformance, and keyboard-only discovery remains a manual check.
